name: Fully Loaded Croissanwich® with Egg
desc: The ultimate BK breakfast sandwich — sausage, crispy bacon, a fresh egg, and melted cheese, all wrapped in a warm, flaky croissant bun. Maximum flavour, maximum satisfaction.

name: Beef Croissan'wich® with Egg
desc: A flame-grilled beef patty layered with a fresh egg and melted cheese in a warm, buttery croissant. The signature smoky beef flavour makes this a firm favourite.

name: Beefacon Croissan'wich® with Egg
desc: The best of beef and bacon together — a flame-grilled beef patty with crispy bacon, egg, and cheese on a golden croissant. Rich, satisfying, and deeply flavourful.

name: Chicken Strips Croissan'wich® with Egg
desc: Crispy chicken strips with a fresh egg and melted cheese in a flaky croissant bun. A satisfying chicken breakfast option with great crunch in every bite.

name: Chick'N Crisp Croissan'wich® with Egg
desc: A lighter crispy chicken fillet with egg and cheese on a warm croissant. Satisfying without being too heavy — perfect for a lighter morning bite.

name: Breakfast King
desc: The monarch of morning burgers. A hearty flame-grilled breakfast burger with all the classic breakfast elements in one royal bite. For those who want a proper morning burger experience.

name: Potato Bites
desc: Golden, crispy potato bites — the must-have breakfast side. Light, crunchy on the outside and fluffy within, these are the perfect companion to any Croissan'wich.

name: Espresso
desc: Bold, rich single-shot espresso. The purest coffee experience on the BK breakfast drinks menu — intense, aromatic, and exactly what a morning needs.

name: Americano
desc: A double shot of espresso diluted with hot water for a smooth, strong black coffee. Classic, clean, and endlessly drinkable alongside any breakfast item.

name: WHOPPER®
desc: The legend itself — flame-grilled beef patty, fresh tomato, lettuce, creamy mayo, ketchup, pickles, and white onion on a toasted sesame bun. Since 1957 and still the best.

name: Double WHOPPER®
desc: Two flame-grilled beef patties stacked with all the classic WHOPPER toppings. When one patty simply isn't enough, the Double WHOPPER delivers double the satisfaction.

name: WHOPPER® with Bacon & Cheese
desc: The classic WHOPPER elevated with crispy bacon and a generous slice of melted cheese. Richer, saltier, and even more satisfying than the original.

data_name: Double WHOPPER with Bacon and Cheese
img: Double WHOPPER with Bacon and Cheese.gmsr.avif
name: Double WHOPPER® with Bacon & Cheese
desc: Two flame-grilled patties with bacon and melted cheese — the pinnacle of WHOPPER indulgence. For serious burger enthusiasts only.

name: Big King
desc: Two juicy flame-grilled beef patties with special Big King sauce on a sesame seed bun. BK's answer to the stacked burger — bold flavour in a classic format.

name: Big King Little King
desc: A compact version of the Big King, delivering all the stacked burger flavour in a more manageable size. Perfect as a snack or a lighter meal option.

name: Big King Royale
desc: The Big King with a royal upgrade — enhanced toppings and sauce for a more premium multi-layer burger experience.

name: Big King Double Royale
desc: Double the patties, double the Royale experience. An impressive stack of flame-grilled beef with premium sauce and toppings.

name: Chicken Royale
desc: BK's flagship chicken burger — a crispy, tender chicken fillet with lettuce and mayo on a soft sesame bun. Simple, classic, and always satisfying.

name: Double Chicken Royale
desc: Two crispy chicken fillets stacked for double the crunch and double the satisfaction. The ultimate BK chicken burger experience.

name: Chicken Royale Bacon & Cheese
desc: The classic Chicken Royale enhanced with crispy bacon and melted cheese. A step up from the original in richness and flavour complexity.

data_name: Double Chicken Royale Bacon and Cheese
name: Double Chicken Royale Bacon & Cheese
desc: Two crispy chicken fillets, crispy bacon strips, and melted cheese. The most fully-loaded BK chicken burger available.

name: Cheeseburger
desc: A simple, classic flame-grilled beef patty with American cheese. Pure, unfussy, and reliably delicious. A timeless menu staple.

name: Double Cheeseburger
desc: Two flame-grilled beef patties with double the American cheese. More meat, more cheese, more satisfaction for those with a bigger appetite.

name: Bacon Double Cheeseburger
desc: Double patties, double cheese, and crispy bacon. The triple threat of the BK value burger range — substantial and full of flavour.

name: Bacon Double Cheese XL
desc: The XL upgrade — extra-large patties, extra cheese, and extra bacon in a bigger bun. For those who want everything bigger and bolder.

name: Hamburger
desc: The original. A single flame-grilled beef patty with classic condiments. Sometimes the simplest things are the most satisfying.

name: Plant-Based WHOPPER®
desc: All the iconic WHOPPER flavour with a plant-based patty. Flame-grilled and loaded with the same fresh toppings — a game-changer for plant-based fast food.

name: Vegan Royale
desc: A plant-based crispy fillet burger with vegan mayo and fresh lettuce. Proves that vegan fast food can be just as satisfying as the original.

name: BBQ Steakhouse Angus
desc: Premium Angus beef patty with smoky BBQ sauce, crispy onions, and all the steakhouse trimmings. A burger for those who want a more sophisticated flavour profile.

name: BBQ Steakhouse Crispy Chicken
desc: Crispy chicken fillet with smoky BBQ steakhouse sauce and toppings. All the richness of the steakhouse range in a chicken format.

name: Wagyu Wellington
desc: An indulgent premium burger featuring Wagyu beef with Wellington-inspired garnishes. BK's most luxurious burger experience — a special treat.

name: The Wagyu
desc: Premium Wagyu beef in a classic Burger King format. Richer marbling means more flavour and a more tender eating experience than standard beef.

name: Chicken Nuggets
desc: Juicy, tender chicken pieces in a crispy golden coating. BK nuggets are consistently rated among the best fast-food nuggets in the UK for texture and flavour.

data_name: 9pc Pringles Sour Cream Onion Chicken Fries
img: 9pc Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Chicken Fries.gmsr.avif
name: 9pc Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Chicken Fries
desc: The legendary Pringles collaboration — chicken fries coated in Sour Cream & Onion flavour. Addictively good and unlike anything else on the BK menu.

name: Garlic & Jalapeño Chicken Fries
desc: A spicy, garlicky coating on crispy chicken fries. For those who love heat and bold flavour in their snacking — seriously addictive.

name: Chilli Cheese Bites
desc: Crispy bites filled with melted cheese and a chilli kick. A punchy, indulgent snack that brings real heat and cheesy satisfaction together perfectly.

name: Burger Buddies (3pc)
desc: Three mini beef sliders — bite-sized burgers that pack a surprising amount of BK's signature flame-grilled flavour. Great as a snack or light meal.

name: Burger Buddies (9pc)
desc: Nine mini sliders for sharing — or not. The 9pc Burger Buddies pack is ideal for groups, parties, or solo guests who seriously love mini burgers.

name: Classic Chicken Melt
desc: Crispy chicken with a generous pour of melted cheese sauce in a toasted bun. Comforting, indulgent, and deeply satisfying.

name: Classic Double Beef Melt
desc: Two flame-grilled beef patties smothered in rich, melted cheese sauce. A decadent option that takes the classic cheeseburger to new heights.

name: Fries
desc: BK's golden, crispy fries — the original and the essential. Salted, crispy, and perfectly consistent every single time.

name: Onion Rings
desc: Crispy battered onion rings with a sweet, tender centre. BK's onion rings are a British fast-food institution and always worth ordering.

name: Loaded King Fries
desc: Golden BK fries topped with rich sauce and toppings. An elevated side experience that turns simple fries into something genuinely special.

name: Loaded King Fries with Bacon
desc: Loaded fries taken to the next level with crispy bacon pieces — the salty, savoury crunch of bacon over creamy loaded fries is irresistible.

name: Truffle Loaded King Fries
desc: BK's most premium side — golden fries drizzled with luxurious truffle sauce. Brings a gourmet touch to your fast-food meal without the gourmet price.

name: Loaded Force Fries
desc: A galaxy-inspired loaded fries creation — special sauce and toppings that pack interstellar flavour. A limited edition favourite.

name: Halloumi Fries
desc: Crispy, golden halloumi in a fries format — squeaky, salty, and satisfying. The best vegetarian side option on the BK menu, beloved by veggies and meat-eaters alike.

name: BBQ Dip Pot
desc: Smoky, tangy BBQ dipping sauce — the classic pairing with nuggets, fries, or onion rings. Always hits the spot.

name: Sweet Chilli Dip Pot
desc: Sweet with a satisfying chilli heat — perfect with chicken nuggets, halloumi fries, or as a burger sauce alternative.

name: Cheddar Cheese Sauce XL
desc: A generous XL portion of warm, melted cheddar cheese dipping sauce. Pour over fries, dip nuggets, or eat with a spoon — we won't judge.

name: BBQ Stacker King Box – Beef
desc: A complete BBQ beef experience in a box — BBQ burger, fries or rings, sauce, and a drink. Great value and genuinely satisfying as a complete meal.

name: BBQ Stacker King Box – Chicken
desc: The chicken version of the BBQ Stacker Box — crispy BBQ chicken burger with sides and drink. Equally satisfying and better value than ordering à la carte.

name: Beef Melt King Box
desc: The Beef Melt as a complete box meal — cheesy beef burger, sides, and drink for a fully loaded lunch experience.

name: Chicken Melt King Box
desc: Complete Chicken Melt meal in a king box — crispy chicken with melted cheese sauce, plus sides and drink for a great all-in-one deal.

name: Chicken Melt Meal
desc: Classic meal deal format — Chicken Melt burger with fries and your choice of drink. Streamlined, satisfying, and great value.

name: Double Beef Melt Meal
desc: The double beef melt as a complete meal — two cheesy beef patties with sides and drink for those with a serious appetite.

name: Beef Melt & Fries
desc: Simple and satisfying — a cheesy beef melt burger paired with golden BK fries. A classic pairing that never disappoints.

name: Chicken Melt & Fries
desc: Crispy chicken melt paired with golden BK fries. The chicken version of the classic burger-and-fries pairing — always a reliable choice.

img: Pringles Sour Cream & Onion King Box – Beef Melts.gmsr.avif
name: Pringles Sour Cream & Onion King Box – Beef Melts
desc: The Pringles collaboration box — a beef melt meal plus Pringles Sour Cream & Onion Chicken Fries. A uniquely flavoured fast-food collaboration.

name: Kids Cheeseburger Meal
desc: A perfectly sized kids' cheeseburger meal with age-appropriate sides and drink. Balanced portions that satisfy little appetites without overwhelming them.

name: Kids Hamburger Meal
desc: The classic kids' hamburger meal — a flame-grilled mini burger with sides and drink sized perfectly for younger diners.

name: Kids Chicken Nuggets Meal
desc: Kids' nugget meal — tender chicken nuggets with sides and a juice drink. The most popular kids' meal option at Burger King UK.

name: Kids Whopper Meal
desc: A mini WHOPPER® experience for younger visitors — all the iconic BK flavour in a perfectly sized kids' meal format.

name: Galactic Mandalorian Chicken Royale Meal
desc: The Force-themed collaboration — Chicken Royale meal in Mandalorian Star Wars packaging. May the flavour be with you.

name: Vanilla Sundae
desc: Creamy vanilla soft serve in a classic sundae cup. Simple, clean, and a perfect palette cleanser after a rich burger meal.

name: Chocolate Sundae
desc: Smooth vanilla soft serve topped with rich chocolate sauce. A timeless dessert combination that satisfies the most persistent sweet tooth.

name: Strawberry Sundae
desc: Creamy soft serve with a sweet, fruity strawberry sauce topping. Light, refreshing, and the perfect summer dessert option.

name: Salted Caramel Sundae
desc: The contemporary favourite — vanilla soft serve with salted caramel drizzle. Sweet, salty, creamy, and utterly irresistible.

name: Grogu's Sundae
desc: The Instagram-famous Baby Yoda inspired sundae from the Mandalorian collaboration. As adorable as it is delicious — a limited edition must-try.

name: Mini Grogu's Sundae
desc: A smaller version of the famous Grogu's Sundae — perfect for little fans of The Mandalorian who want their very own cute dessert.

name: Vanilla Milkshake
desc: Thick and creamy vanilla milkshake — sweet, cold, and satisfying. The classic choice when you want something indulgent to drink.

name: Chocolate Milkshake
desc: Rich, indulgent chocolate milkshake made with soft serve ice cream and chocolate flavouring. The quintessential fast food dessert drink.

name: Strawberry Milkshake
desc: Sweet, fruity, and refreshingly pink — BK's strawberry milkshake is a crowd-pleaser for all ages.

name: Salted Caramel Milkshake
desc: A premium milkshake with the on-trend salted caramel flavour — rich, sweet, and salty in perfect harmony.

name: Twix Shake
desc: A milkshake inspired by the Twix chocolate bar — caramel, biscuit, and chocolate in a creamy, drinkable format. A chocolate lover's dream.

name: Smarties Fusion
desc: BK's soft serve blended with colourful Smarties pieces. A playful, vibrant dessert that brings out the inner child in everyone who orders it.

name: Twix Fusion
desc: Soft serve blended with pieces of Twix bar — caramel and biscuit chunks in creamy ice cream. Indulgent, sweet, and impossible to resist.

name: King Fusion – Smarties
desc: BK's signature King Fusion ice cream treat with Smarties blended in. Colourful, fun, and utterly delicious.

name: Mini Smarties Fusion
desc: A smaller portion of the Smarties Fusion — ideal for those who want a lighter sweet treat or for younger diners.

name: Mini Twix Fusion
desc: All the Twix fusion goodness in a smaller, more manageable portion. Perfect for kids or as a light dessert option.

name: Ben & Jerry's Cookie Dough
desc: The world-famous Ben & Jerry's Cookie Dough ice cream, available at BK. Vanilla ice cream with chunks of cookie dough throughout — a global favourite.

data_name: Small Ben Jerrys Chocolate Fudge Brownie
img: Small Ben & Jerry’s Chocolate Fudge Brownie.gmsr.avif
name: Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Fudge Brownie
desc: Chocolate ice cream with rich fudge brownie chunks from Ben & Jerry's. The ultimate chocolate indulgence for dessert lovers.

data_name: Small Ben Jerrys Caramel Chew Chew
img: Small Ben & Jerry’s Caramel Chew Chew.gmsr.avif
name: Ben & Jerry's Caramel Chew Chew
desc: Caramel ice cream with caramel ribbons and fudge pieces — Ben & Jerry's caramel-lover's dream in a pot at BK.

name: Chocolate Brownie Cheesecake Bar
desc: Indulgent chocolate brownie cheesecake in convenient bar form — rich, fudgy, and creamy all at once. A dessert bar worth every calorie.

name: Gooey Salted Caramel Cheesecake Bar
desc: Gooey salted caramel filling in a creamy cheesecake bar — sweet, salty, and extraordinarily satisfying as a post-meal dessert.

name: Strawberry Milkshake Cheesecake Bar
desc: Strawberry milkshake flavoured cheesecake bar — fruity, creamy, and light. A fresh dessert bar option that doesn't feel overly heavy.

name: Coca-Cola®
desc: The world's most iconic soft drink. Ice cold, perfectly carbonated — the classic pairing with any BK burger.

name: Diet Coca-Cola®
desc: All the Coca-Cola flavour with significantly fewer calories. The go-to choice for those watching their calorie intake without sacrificing the Coke experience.

name: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar
desc: The full Coca-Cola taste experience with zero sugar. Reformulated to taste closer to original Coke than Diet Coke — many prefer it.

name: Fanta Zero
desc: Fruity, fizzy Fanta flavour with zero sugar. A great lighter alternative to the regular Fanta for those monitoring sugar intake.

name: Sprite Zero
desc: Crisp, clean lemon-lime flavour with zero sugar. A refreshing, palate-cleansing choice that pairs well with rich, flavourful BK burgers.

name: Dr Pepper Zero
desc: The unique 23-flavour Dr Pepper blend in a zero sugar format. For those who want something a little different from the mainstream cola options.

name: Frozen Fanta – Blue Raspberry
desc: An icy blue raspberry frozen slushie — cold, sweet, and instantly refreshing. Perfect on a warm day or as a fun treat alongside any meal.

name: Frozen Fanta – Strawberry
desc: Sweet, fruity strawberry frozen slushie — a popular choice for younger diners and anyone who loves a fresh, cold fruit drink.

name: Frozen Fanta – Strawberry & Blue Raspberry
desc: The best of both frozen worlds combined — strawberry and blue raspberry together in one vibrant, dual-tone frozen drink.

name: Monster Energy Original 500ml
desc: The original green Monster energy drink in a full 500ml can. The go-to energy drink for those who need a serious afternoon or post-breakfast boost.

name: Monster Mango Loco 500ml
desc: Tropical mango flavoured Monster energy drink — all the energy boost of the original with a fruity, exotic twist.

name: Monster Ultra White Zero Sugar 500ml
desc: Light, crisp citrus flavour with zero sugar. The cleaner energy drink option for health-conscious consumers who still need the Monster energy kick.

name: Cappuccino
desc: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and frothed milk foam. The classic Italian breakfast coffee — smooth, balanced, and deeply satisfying.

name: Latte
desc: Espresso with generous steamed milk for a longer, creamier coffee drink. The most accessible coffee drink on the menu — perfect for coffee beginners and regulars alike.

name: Flat White
desc: Strong espresso with velvety micro-foamed milk in a smaller volume than a latte. The specialist's choice — intense coffee flavour with silky texture.

name: Hot Chocolate
desc: Rich, warming, deeply chocolatey — the perfect non-coffee hot drink. Comforting in winter, indulgent year-round, and great alongside any breakfast item.

name: Tea
desc: A proper British cup of tea — hot, strong, and perfectly brewed. Nothing starts the day in the UK quite like a good cup of tea alongside breakfast.

name: Semi-Skimmed Milk
desc: Cold, fresh semi-skimmed milk. A pure, nutritious drink option for those who prefer something simple alongside their meal.

name: Bottled Water
desc: Clean, still water in a convenient bottle. The straightforward, calorie-free hydration option for any meal or occasion.

data_name: Innocent Kids Juicy Water Apples And Mangoes
img: Innocent Kids Juicy Water Apples And Mangoes.gmsr.avif
name: Innocent Kids Juicy Water – Apples & Mangoes
desc: A healthy, fruit-based juicy water for children from the Innocent Kids range. Low sugar, naturally flavoured, and a great kids' drinks choice at BK.

data_name: Innocent Kids Juicy Water Apples And Strawberries
img: Innocent Kids Juicy Water Apples And Strawberries.gmsr.avif
name: Innocent Kids Juicy Water – Apples & Strawberries
desc: Another delicious Innocent Kids option — apple and strawberry fruit water that's refreshing, healthy, and perfect for younger BK diners.
